description: Source code for the ReverbContext class implementing reverb effect processing, control, and preset management in Android audio effects.

classes.name: ReverbContext
classes.description: Class managing reverb effect state, control parameters, preset loading, and audio processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the reverb context, allocates resources, and sets default parameters.

methods.name: deInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the reverb context, freeing resources.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the reverb effect.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the reverb effect.

methods.name: setVolumeStereo
methods.description: Sets stereo volume levels.

methods.name: setPresetReverbPreset
methods.description: Sets the next preset reverb configuration.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbRoomLevel
methods.description: Sets the room level for reverb.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbRoomHfLevel
methods.description: Sets the high-frequency level for reverb.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbDecayTime
methods.description: Sets the decay time for reverb.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbDecayHfRatio
methods.description: Sets the high-frequency decay ratio.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbLevel
methods.description: Sets the reverb level.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay for reverb.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbDiffusion
methods.description: Sets the diffusion for reverb.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbDensity
methods.description: Sets the density for reverb.

methods.name: setEnvironmentalReverbBypass
methods.description: Bypasses the reverb effect.

methods.name: loadPreset
methods.description: Loads a preset reverb configuration.

methods.name: initControlParameter
methods.description: Initializes control parameters for the reverb effect.

methods.name: convertLevel
methods.description: Converts level from OpenSL ES format to internal format.

methods.name: convertHfLevel
methods.description: Converts HF level from OpenSL ES format to internal format.

methods.name: lvmProcess
methods.description: Processes audio frames applying reverb effect.
